turns.prompt_text: I have hellofresh and I get food from them but I would like to stop their services. I'm often on sure about how to go about doing that
turns.response_html:
It’s understandable to feel a bit unsure about the process—subscription services often make the "Cancel" button a little harder to find than the "Sign Up" one.

Since you’re already a HelloFresh user, the most important thing to keep in mind is their 5-day cutoff rule. To avoid being charged for your next box, you must cancel by 11:59 PM PST exactly five days before your next scheduled delivery.

Here is the straightforward way to handle it:

How to Cancel (Web Browser)

  1. Log In: Go to HelloFresh.com and log into your account.
  2. Access Settings: Click on your name/profile icon in the top-right corner and select Account Settings.
  3. Find Your Plan: Scroll to the bottom of the Plan Settings page until you see the "Subscription Status" section.
  4. Cancel Plan: Click Cancel Plan.
  5. Navigate the Prompts: They will offer you discounts or the option to "Pause" instead. If you're sure you want to stop, keep clicking "Cancel Anyway" until you reach the final confirmation screen.
  6. Check for Email: You should receive a confirmation email shortly after. Keep this email—it’s your proof if a charge accidentally goes through later.

How to Cancel (Mobile App)

  1. Tap the Settings gear icon (usually under the "Profile" or "Account" tab).
  2. Select Plan Settings or Subscription Details.
  3. Scroll to the bottom and tap Cancel Plan.
  4. Follow the prompts to confirm.

A Pro-Tip if You're Worried About Timing

If you aren't sure if you'll make the 5-day deadline for the very next box, go into your "My Menu" tab and manually "Skip" the next 3 or 4 weeks. This buys you a month of safety where you won't be charged, giving you plenty of time to go through the formal cancellation steps without stress.

If you hit any snags or if the "Cancel" button isn't appearing for some reason, their customer service team is usually quite fast via the Live Chat on their website.
